narrative.overview: The visual authority is prototype/index.html and its v9 README: a print-shop test sheet, not a financial dashboard.

rules.name: The State Ink Rule
rules.body: Preserve the distinction between live red and saved green, with accompanying text rather than color alone.

rules.name: The Three Roles Rule
rules.body: Do not replace the display face with the label face. All duration numerals use tabular figures.

dos: Do preserve the prototype's palette and three type roles.
Do expose keyboard focus without doubling field outlines.
Do keep off-hours recordings visible above the calendar.
donts: Don't seed production data with prototype examples.
Don't invent a dark theme or replace paper with a generic dashboard shell.
Don't require a network connection to render typography.
